mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${TNAME} ( SEQ NUMBER(11) NOT NULL, CHANNEL VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL, TYPE VARCHAR2(1) NOT NULL, PHONE VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL, CALLBACK VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL, USE_YN VARCHAR2(1), REG_ID VARCHAR2(12), REG_TIME VARCHAR2(14), MOD_ID VARCHAR2(12), MOD_TIME VARCHAR2(14), REMARK VARCHAR2(100), CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY ( SEQ ) )
CREATE SEQUENCE ${tableName}_SEQ START WITH 1 MAXVALUE 99999999 MINVALUE 1 CYCLE CACHE 20 NOORDER
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ AS sequence, CHANNEL, PHONE, CALLBACK, TYPE, USE_YN, REG_ID AS registration_id, REG_TIME AS registration_date, MOD_ID AS modification_id, MOD_TIME AS modification_date, REMARK FROM ${tableName} WHERE USE_YN = #{parameter.useYn} AND CHANNEL = #{parameter.channel}
